$comment: The EXCEPTION_* status names of <windows.h>, each compared against the SDK header's own value by a _Static_assert, so a wrong value in the shipped header fails the COMPILE on every host. The values were MEASURED 2026-10-08 with the reference compiler (cl 19.51 x64, a program printing each name the header defines), and this same file compiles there. Before this example the shipped header declared two of the family, and a filter naming any other did not compile. At run time the program catches an integer division by zero by its name: exit 42. ON A HOST THAT IS NOT WINDOWS this file is built and not run: the assertions hold in every compile of it, and `program/test_guarded_region_examples_on_every_host` builds both arms for pe64 on every host and reads the scope records of its two regions.
